subject: Pilot economics & ops: prioritized savings levers and next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel.santos@luminpay.com>, Kelsey Tran <kelsey.tran@luminpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot economics & ops: prioritized savings levers and next steps

Thanks for the time this morning, Miguel & Kelsey — good conversation. Below is a concise recap of the pain, goals, and the pragmatic levers we discussed to make an affordable pilot happen. I also attached a brief SOW draft and the usage estimates you shared.

Key pain points (what you told us):
- High per-user inference spend on the real-time recommendations flow (spike during peak hours).
- Latency targets: 60–120ms p95 for the widget; hit-and-miss today when load spikes.
- Procurement budget ceiling: ~$12k/month earmarked for pilots; procurement needs line-itemized pricing.

Goals for a 6–8 week pilot:
- Validate 50–70% token-cost reduction across average session using batching + prefix caching without exceeding 120ms p95.
- Measure end-to-end latency in production-like traffic and confirm quality parity on 1k sample prompts.
- Deliver an ops playbook so you can extrapolate monthly TCO to 100k daily active users.

Prioritized levers we recommend (quick ROI framing):
1) Prefix/KV caching (low lift) — expected 20–35% token reduction for common intents; minimal infra change.
2) Micro-batching at the edge for concurrent widget requests — 15–30% token savings while preserving p95 when tuned.
3) Model selection & quantization profile (medium lift) — choose a slightly smaller variant for low-risk intents: 25–45% token & compute savings.
4) Fallback routing for heavy tails — cost control for rare, expensive long-context requests.

Estimated pilot economics (back-of-envelope):
- Baseline monthly token spend (your numbers): ~1.4B tokens/month = ~$22k/month at list.
- With caching + batching (conservative): ~45% token reduction => ~770M tokens => ~$12k/month.
- Pilot discount + committed min (Redwood): we can structure a pilot package at $7k–9k/mo depending on SLA targets and whether you want dedicated capacity.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-sow-draft.pdf (SOW, 3 pages), luminpay-usage-estimates.csv (your usage broken by flow).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Miguel / Kelsey: confirm procurement timeline and whether legal needs an NDA prior to SOW.
- If $7k–9k/mo pilot looks feasible, we'll: (a) send a cleaned SOW, (b) provision a monitoring dashboard, and (c) schedule an ops sync to run a traffic replay test.
- Marissa / Ben: I copied you for pricing options and a compact ops checklist we can share with LuminPay.

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with a tagged SOW and two pricing options by EOD.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Pilot economics & ops: prioritized savings levers and next steps

Thanks Sofia — solid recap. A couple quick clarifications before we loop procurement: 

- The $7k–9k band is promising. Can you provide a simple three-line ROI table showing expected monthly spend at baseline vs. with levers and the delta for both conservative (45% reduction) and optimistic (60% reduction) scenarios? Procurement likes to see delta to justify the pilot.
- On the latency side: can Redwood guarantee p95 <= 120ms in the pilot? We need that called out in the SOW if possible (we can accept a testing SLA with specific test cases).
- Timeline: procurement will need an itemized quote + vendor form filled. We can turn quickly if the SOW has clear acceptance criteria.

We’ll await the updated SOW and the ROI table. Kelsey — looping you to flag budget committee availability next Wednesday.

Best,
Miguel
Head of Product | LuminPay
miguel.santos@luminpay.com | +1 206-555-9988

- ROI table: table attached (summary below) — conservative (45% token saving) and optimistic (60% saving) scenarios with monthly spend and projected net delta.
- Latency SLA for pilot: Redwood can commit to p95 <= 120ms for the primary widget under the replay test conditions documented in the SOW. We’ll include measurement methodology and test cases in the acceptance criteria.
- Procurement pack: will include an itemized quote, SOW, SOC 2 scan link, and a short vendor form.

Pilot pricing options (two flavors):
A) Shared-hosted pilot (cheapest) — $7,000/mo, 8-week pilot, monitoring dashboard, 1 admin seat, standard SLAs (replay test SLA above).
B) Reserved pilot (dedicated capacity for the widget) — $9,500/mo, higher throughput guarantee and priority routing.

Next steps (what I’ll do):
- Share ROI spreadsheet and updated SOW by close of business today.
- Add explicit acceptance criteria + replay test steps to the SOW.
- Ben will prepare a short ops checklist for the initial integration.

Sofia — if you can confirm LuminPay’s preferred pilot flavor, I’ll route the paperwork to legal and procurement in parallel.

Cheers,
